projects.title: Fixo Flow
projects.summary: Your voice, in the apps you already use.
projects.description: An open-source desktop dictation tool with local English speech recognition, a personal dictionary, writing styles and recoverable history.
projects.problem: Typing interrupts the flow of an idea. Fixo Flow brings English dictation to everyday applications while keeping recognition on the computer.
projects.contribution: Built the local speech workflow and desktop product: microphone capture, recognition, formatting, history, OS insertion and distribution paths.
projects.imageAlt: Actual Fixo Flow macOS writing styles interface
projects.architecture: Microphone capture -> Local Whisper recognition -> Dictionary and formatting -> History and clipboard -> Attempted application insertion

layers.title: Capture
layers.detail: Bounded microphone chunks enter the local recognition pipeline.

layers.title: Local inference
layers.detail: Whisper recognition uses MLX on Mac and a CPU engine in other platform previews.

layers.title: Application integration
layers.detail: Dictionary and offline formatting feed history, clipboard and attempted paste.

decisions.title: Recognition stays local
decisions.detail: Local inference avoids a cloud transcription dependency. Optional update checks are separate from recognition.

decisions.title: Recover the words
decisions.detail: History and clipboard provide a recovery path when insertion into another application fails.

limitations: Experimental English dictation preview; multilingual and Hinglish recognition are not delivered in the reviewed release.
Accuracy depends on speech, microphone and hardware. OS support and publisher signing have platform-specific limitations.

evidence.label: Source and current scope
evidence.detail: Recognition pipeline, privacy model and preview limitations.

evidence.label: Packaging workflow
evidence.detail: Configured installer builds and checks, not a claim that a current CI run passed.

projects.title: PacketLark
projects.summary: A local workbench for requests, tests and API discovery.
projects.description: An open-source TypeScript and Node.js API workbench with collections, isolated scripts, repeatable tests, traffic inspection and inferred OpenAPI exports.
projects.problem: API development needs more than a Send button: repeatable requests, inspectable traffic and tests that travel with the workspace.
projects.contribution: Built the local API product across its browser interface, HTTP engine, workspace persistence, isolated scripting, CLI integrations and packaging.
projects.imageAlt: Actual PacketLark API workbench preview from its repository
projects.architecture: Browser interface -> Local Node server -> HTTP and script engines -> Workspace files

layers.title: Interface
layers.detail: Compose requests, inspect responses and organize collections and environments.

layers.title: HTTP engine
layers.detail: Local forwarding, cookie sessions and isolated QuickJS test scripts.

layers.title: Workspace files
layers.detail: Readable resource files with ownership and conflict reconciliation.

decisions.title: A local workspace
decisions.detail: Collections and environments remain inspectable files. The server binds locally rather than acting as a public multi-user service.

decisions.title: Separate script execution
decisions.detail: QuickJS isolates imported scripts from Node object references with resource limits and a narrow bridge.

limitations: The published GitHub Pages website is a product site/sample preview; it does not run the Node workbench.
Not a complete Postman replacement. Protocol clients, cloud collaboration and some recovery workflows remain outside current scope.

evidence.label: Source and current scope
evidence.detail: Supported HTTP workflows, setup and limitations.

evidence.label: Verification workflow
evidence.detail: Configured Node 22/24 build, tests and package checks.

evidence.label: Product website
evidence.detail: Installation guide and labelled sample preview.

projects.title: Framecast Studio
projects.summary: One studio. Two formats. Your screen, composed.
projects.description: A native macOS studio for composing screen and camera scenes, recording horizontal and vertical outputs, and developing a private broadcast workflow.
projects.problem: Screen recordings need different framing for landscape and portrait. A composition tool should make those outputs explicit and editable.
projects.contribution: Built native scene composition and media workflows using SwiftUI, AppKit, ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation, with separate recording outputs and local control.
projects.imageAlt: Actual local Framecast Studio scene editor during development
projects.architecture: Scene composition -> Native capture and audio mix -> Encoded outputs -> Local recording or streaming transport

layers.title: Scene composition
layers.detail: Separate horizontal and vertical layouts share source inputs with independent framing.

layers.title: Native media
layers.detail: Screen/camera capture and a timestamped audio mix feed the composition.

layers.title: Encoded outputs
layers.detail: AVFoundation recording and FFmpeg streaming transport have separate responsibilities.

decisions.title: Two deliberate outputs
decisions.detail: Horizontal and vertical compositions keep their own geometry and recording settings.

decisions.title: Own resource lifetimes
decisions.detail: Capture permits, cancellation paths and finalization are explicit parts of the media pipeline.

limitations: In development and not publicly released in the reviewed source. No public repository or download is advertised.
Broad device compatibility, sustained high-resolution performance and complete broadcast recovery are not established.

evidence.label: Development scope
evidence.detail: Local implementation reviewed: native composition, separate output canvases, recording and local control. Public source will be linked after publication.

projects.title: FixO CLI
projects.description: An autonomous, open-source AI coding platform that lives in your terminal. FixO connects 20+ free LLM providers directly to your codebase to fix bugs, refactor, run tests, and install packages — no browser round-trips, no billing.
projects.architecture: Terminal CLI Engine (Node.js) -> Tree-Sitter AST Workspace Indexer -> Multi-Provider LLM Router (FreeLLMAPI) -> Shadow Staging & LSP Syntax Verifier -> Autonomous Test Loop.
features: Multi-AI router across 20+ free providers with automatic failover (FreeLLMAPI)
Self-correcting autonomous loop with a built-in test runner that iterates until tests pass
Atomic shadow staging, LSP pre-save syntax checks, and a credential vault that scrubs secrets before the LLM
Tree-Sitter AST workspace indexing for JS, TS, Python & Go
